data_status_note: Coverage varies by dzongkhag and year because rows require a printed Religious institutions observation.

boundary_set.vintage: geoBoundaries gbOpen BTN ADM1, boundary year 2010

site_snapshot.basis: Annual printed administrative-register observations pooled across Dzongkhag at a Glance editions.
site_snapshot.notes: Each row uses the most recent edition that prints its year.

source_datasets.name: Dzongkhag at a Glance: Religion & Culture

licence.name: No stated reuse grant; review required
licence.attribution: National Statistics Bureau of Bhutan; source: Dzongkhag Administration

source_datasets.citation: National Statistics Bureau of Bhutan, Dzongkhag at a Glance, editions 2016-2023.
source_datasets.access_limits: Cached Wayback captures; the live host was unreachable during retrieval.
source_datasets.notes: The register counts infrastructure. Bhutan's PHCB 2017 publishes no religion variable or affiliation table.

indicators.label: Religious institutions
indicators.description: Administrative-register count of religious institutions compiled by each Dzongkhag Administration. The count measures infrastructure. It does not measure religious affiliation, belief, or population.
indicators.method: Most recent edition that prints each dzongkhag-year observation; no-data marks and unruled duplicate headings contribute no observation.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Twenty Bhutan dzongkhags; years without a printed observation are absent.
indicators.quality_notes: Rows flag register revisions and register redefinitions.

visual_layers.label: Religious institutions
visual_layers.description: Dzongkhag administrative-register count by printed year.
visual_layers.aggregation_rule: Use the printed dzongkhag-year count without aggregation.
